texts: On day 190 of Year 1, Coraline Ash lit the lantern of the Harbor Station at sundown.
The lantern showed mist-light at night.
The mist-light attracted a handful of nightmoths.
Coraline Ash counted four nightmoths at the lantern at the third watch.
The nightmoths landed on the lantern.
The nightmoths left silken threads on the lantern.
Coraline Ash collected a small heap of silken threads from the lantern at dawn on day 191 of Year 1.
Coraline Ash carried the silken threads to Cauldron Hall.
Hesper boiled the silken threads in sea-water on day 191 of Year 1.
Mire-essence formed in a cauldron by evening.
Hesper stored the mire-essence in a clay vessel.
Coraline Ash drew the stored mire-essence at sundown on day 191 of Year 1.

q1_issues.issue: (Cardinality sk_group_1 4) stamps the exact count of the indefinite "four nightmoths" onto the "a handful of nightmoths" group from the previous sentence, asserting an identification and a size the text never states and colliding with that same symbol's CardinalityPhrase "a handful".
"four nightmoths" is an indefinite and should mint its own group witness rather than reuse sk_group_1.

"a small heap of silken threads" is an indefinite, but the parse types the sentence-8 thread group as that heap instead of minting a new witness, asserting that the collected heap is exactly the threads left on the lantern.
Same merge: (Member sk_threads_1 small) puts the indefinite heap's size property onto the earlier thread group.

review.notes: Role assignment, compound decomposition (silken exposed as a material adjective while clay/mire/sea stay unexposed noun modifiers) and "by evening" as TimeAtMost are all correct. The verb lemma of "lit" and the head noun of "mist-light" both land on the symbol light, a homonym collision the lemmatization rule does not disambiguate.

issues.reason: (Cardinality sk_group_1 4) stamps an exact size on the group introduced as "a handful of nightmoths", asserting both that the four counted at the third watch are all the moths the mist-light attracted and that the handful numbers exactly four — neither is in the text, and Core patterns' "assert only what the text states" bars it.

"four nightmoths" is a bare indefinite, and Names and casing fixes that "an existential witness is anonymous — mint a fresh sk_<class>_<n> each time; witnesses don't corefer" (an indefinite is always a new witness even when one of that class is already in play), so the count event's Theme must be a fresh group symbol, not sk_group_1.

"a small heap of silken threads" is an indefinite and takes its own witness on the "a flock of birds" pattern of Coordination & plurals — (Member sk_heap_1 heap) (GroupOf sk_heap_1 silken_thread); typing the sentence-8 deposit group as that heap asserts the collected heap is exactly and entirely the threads the moths left, which the text does not state.

Same merge: (Member sk_threads_1 small) predicates the newly introduced heap's size of the moths' thread group, attaching to sk_threads_1 a property the sentence attributes only to the indefinite heap.

new_gaps: Fictional-calendar day-of-year ordinal ("day 190 of Year 1", "day 191 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is specified as a calendar day-of-month term and nothing marks a day-of-year index, so the emitted (Day 190) / (Day 191) are read by the seeded date-ordering rules as month days; a licensed form would need a granularity term that carries "nth day of the year".

Noun/verb homonymy collapses onto one symbol: "lit" lemmatizes to the event class light while "mist-light" decomposes to the kind genus light ((Inheritance mist_light light)), and the lemmatization rule offers no part-of-speech disambiguation, so an event class and a noun kind share one symbol and can unify.
adjudication.defect_summary: For issues 0 and 1 the compliant form mints a fresh counted group for "four nightmoths" — (GroupOf sk_group_2 nightmoth) (Cardinality sk_group_2 4) filling the count event's Theme — leaving sk_group_1 carrying only its CardinalityPhrase "a handful". For issues 2 and 3 the compliant form mints a fresh witness for "a small heap of silken threads" — (Member sk_heap_1 heap) (GroupOf sk_heap_1 silken_thread) (Member sk_heap_1 small) as the collect event's Theme — with sk_threads_1 left as the threads the moths deposited. Both fixes are fully licensed by the existing witness and group machinery, so no gap blocks a compliant re-parse.
adjudication.notes: The rest of the passage holds up: roles, the PartOf/Name handling of "the lantern of the Harbor Station" and "Cauldron Hall", compound decomposition (silken exposed as an adjectival modifier while mire/sea/clay stay unexposed noun modifiers) and "by evening" as TimeAtMost all follow the instruction set. All four confirmed issues are one error repeated — an indefinite NP reusing an earlier witness instead of minting its own.
